input.quote: Charges for applicable Services will be specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms. Charges can be specified as one-time, installment, recurring, or usage. IBM will invoice such Charges when they begin or are due as set forth in Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: The Base Terms impose no minimum purchase commitment, committed volume, take-or-pay or shortfall charge on Customer. Section 4.1 (p0052) ties Charges solely to Services specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms (one-time, installment, recurring or usage), and Section 11.5 Capacity Planning (p0142) only allocates responsibility for sizing decisions to Customer rather than committing Customer to any capacity or volume. Customer also retains a monthly termination for convenience right on one month's notice (p0044–p0045), so no take-or-pay lock-in exists. This meets our preferred position, so no redline is proposed. Residual watch item only (outside this rule): Section 3.4(b) preserves "early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments" (p0046) — those attachments are not part of this document, and we should confirm at Order Form stage that any such charge is a true-up of amounts for services actually ordered rather than a penalty or disguised minimum commitment.
